data.long_meaning: The name Viktorija is derived from the Baltic word ‘Viktis’, which means 'God of Victory'. The name gained popularity in Eastern Europe and has been used as a feminine variant since the Middle Ages. The name Viktorija carries the meaning “Victory of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Viktorija usually hope their child will grow to embody victory of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
